digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent guidance and Rebar tracker integration
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local Rebar clone, direct Gerrit access, shell network access, or mounted tracker despite having GitHub connector and repository visibility, creating ambiguity about which operations are safe.

Native ticket creation becomes impossible when both tracker-worktree access and network/remote access (or native rebar/rebar-mcp binary availability) fail; guidance must define this rule precisely to avoid fallback confusion.

The fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id, with agent-generated UUID4 ticket_id becoming source_id on import, enabling idempotent re-import without hand-transcription.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path (accepting NDJSON, assigning fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, idempotent by source_id); dry-run mode silently skips malformed records with no counter increment, detectable only by comparing would_create + skipped against total record count.

Existing guidance does not teach environment-capability detection, does not prohibit hand-authored event mutations or GitHub Contents API writes to the tickets branch, and does not document the precise import mechanism semantics or dry-run malformation-detection behavior.
